description: Emergencias y Protección Civil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The database includes detailed information on various emergency and civil protection facilities and services located in different municipalities. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The portal shows the English title as "Emergencies and Civil Protection" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Málaga. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/licence/CC_BY_4_0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
